general_information.name: I THINK IT’S ROBERT… DO YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY HEALTH CARD OR SOMETHING LIKE THAT?
general_information.address: It’s on Lakeshore Road in Oakville… I’m drawing a blank on whether you wanted the whole thing or just the street.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly I’ve lost interest in things, and I’ve been pretty fatigued. Sleep has been off too, and I’ve been keeping to myself more than usual.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to enjoy life again and keep active.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Carbidopa-levodopa.; Dose: 25/100 mg, one tablet three times daily.; Start Or Duration: I started it in 2024, I think.; Side Effects: Occasional nausea.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes — latanoprost eye drops.; Dose: One drop in each eye nightly.; Start Or Duration: I started that in 2021.; Side Effects: None that I know of.
Medication 3: Name Or Description: Yes, one more — allopurinol.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Start Or Duration: I started it in 2019.; Side Effects: None that I know of.

medical_history.medical_conditions: I’ve got Parkinson’s disease, and I think that’s the main one.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My granddaughter.; Diagnosis Or Condition: ADHD.; Additional Details: She was diagnosed when she was 9, that’s about all I know.

education_employment_legal_history.highest_education: I’ve got a bachelor’s degree, and I was a teacher.
education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Oakville District School Board.; Job Title: High school science teacher.; Dates: 1978 to 2013.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and grew up, just kind of had a normal childhood I think.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School was the big thing, and then I became a teacher. Not much else stands out to me.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’ve been married for 49 years to a supportive wife.
personal_history.future_goals: Mostly to enjoy life and manage this illness.
